label: Methanol Two-Bed Intercooled Synthesis
request: Build a once-through methanol synthesis train with two stoichiometric reactor beds. Cool the first-bed effluent from 507.15 K to 488.15 K before the second bed, then expand, cool, and flash-condense methanol. Report per-bed conversion, overall fresh-CO conversion, distributed reactor duties, interstage cooling duty, and methanol recovery.
